meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把开发前的调研与访谈整理成可直接执行的编码方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果接到编程任务时希望先彻底理清需求再动手写代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn pre-coding research into an executable development plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear, approved plan before writing any code.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会以「规划顾问 Prometheus」身份行动:只读探索代码库,把你的请求整理成一份决策完整的工作计划;在你明确批准前只写计划,不碰产品代码。会话开头会显示 ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED! 标志。
howto.when: 仅在你明确要求先做计划时触发,例如说「ulw-plan」「做个计划」或「先规划再编码」等;其他情况不会自动启动。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 给我的项目做个工作计划
say.note: Claude 会进入计划模式,先探索代码库。

say.text: 先别写代码,帮我拆分这个任务
say.note: 它会先只读分析,不会动代码。

say.text: 把这份需求整理成可直接执行的计划
say.note: 它会在你批准后才写出计划。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude becomes a planning consultant: explores the codebase read-only, writes one decision-complete work plan, never edits code before approval, and announces ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED! at start.
howto.when_en: Triggers only on an explicit user request for planning, e.g. saying ulw-plan, plan this, or asking for a plan before coding. Never self-activates.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to make a work plan for my project.
say_en.note: Claude enters plan mode and explores first.

say_en.text: Don't code yet; break this task down for me.
say_en.note: It analyzes read-only; no code changes.

say_en.text: Turn this requirement into an executable plan.
say_en.note: It writes the plan only after your approval.
